Feiruz

Overview

Feiruz is a thief who helps Kir conceal his conspicuous face beneath a cloth, using fear of disease as a disguise. Later he asks for help rescuing his fiancée Aliya from prison. He dies during the escape, leaving Aliya grieving and determined to retaliate. [1, 2, 3]

Shelter at Rindeil’s estate

Rindeil welcomes Kel and her companion to his estate. Kir’s learning gives them common ground, though the collector’s chief concern remains his spiders. Karim, who manages the household and formerly performed on stage, becomes a source of contacts and rumours about another Joon. Feiruz helps Kir hide his conspicuous face beneath cloth, exploiting the fear of disease. Rindeil’s requests include obtaining a meteorite sample in exchange for a rare specimen for his collection. This period of refuge lets Kir search for information, but its safety depends on the owner’s willingness to risk his household. [4, 5, 1, 6, 7, 8]

Feiruz’s last rescue

Feiruz asks Kir to repay his help by rescuing his imprisoned fiancée Aliya. He dies during the escape. Kel urges the grieving Aliya to avenge him and identifies the man who struck the fatal blow. Kir objects to deliberate revenge, but their companions insist on their code. The death of the prison commandant brings searches across the city. Fearing for his collection, Rindeil withdraws his protection, though he says Kir may return once the danger passes. Aliya then leads Kir and Kel to the Last Shelter and speaks for them before Brother Khatul. [2, 3, 9, 10, 11]
